text:
Claude Giroux is 38, and Ottawa is using him as a 17-minute middle-six forward who still makes plays. Three goals and 11 points in 18 games, eight of them assists, and only one on the power play.

The underlying numbers are kinder than the points. The Senators take 57% of expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on, six points better than without him, yet they have scored 2.8 fewer goals than those chances deserve. His own finishing is dead even with his expected goals. Our range has his points per 60 right where he is now, so this is roughly who he is.

Evolving-Hockey ranked him 47th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement in 2025-26, and noted he takes chances away (89th percentile), which is a quiet reason he keeps getting the minutes. He played 1,000 games in Philadelphia and came into this season with 1,165 career points. Our range has him at 41 to 62 points.
headline: Giroux at 38: fewer points, steady play
